verdict.rationale: Letta is itself an agent platform where users create, resume, and delegate tasks to built-in stateful agents via CLI, desktop, or web app (e.g. onboarding 'Tutor' agent, background 'dreaming' subagents, /btw forked side-tasks), with persistent memory and cross-session/device continuity. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of delegation quality/reliability beyond mixed community sentiment about the memory/agent concept.
